images.caption: Figure 1:SpatialASM improves LVLM spatial reasoning by eliciting active exploration and imagination. (a) The qualitative example shows that the baseline LVLM (red) fails to associate objects across views, whereas our model (green) uses the internal viewpoint-planning skill and reasons over the imagined observation to reach the correct answer. (b) Quantitative experiments demonstrate that SpatialASM delivers consistent performance gains on seven benchmarks.

Figure 3:Overview of SpatialASM.(1)An allocentric novel-view generator (NVG,GG) renders the scene from a queried viewpoint, and GeoP measures how much a rendered view perturbs the 3D reconstruction of the inputs.(2)An LVLM plans viewpoints,GGrenders them, and filtered trajectories are converted to captions for SFT.(3)GeoP-filtered candidate views form verifiable perspective-taking questions for RL.

Figure 4:Evaluation of external ASM. We evaluate vanilla VLM reasoning, and two external ASM strategies with different viewpoint-planning methods. Both planning-based settings invoke SpatialASM-NVG and condition the final reasoning on the original and generated observations.
